title: Bodycam: NJ Mom Allegedly Stabbed and Drowned Her Kids
description:
A New Jersey mom is accused of stabbing her infant before drowning the one-year-old and her other three-year-old child. Naomi Elkins allegedly drowned the children in two separate bathtubs before Lakewood Township police were called about a cardiac arrest emergency. Both children died. Elkins was charged with two counts of murder, possession of a weapon for an unlawful purpose and unlawful possession of a weapon. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
